notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla defines the inbound combat-log family: SMSG_SPELLNONMELEEDAMAGELOG, SMSG_PERIODICAURALOG (per-AuraType tick shapes), SMSG_SPELLHEALLOG, SMSG_SPELLENERGIZELOG, SMSG_SPELLDAMAGESHIELD, SMSG_ENVIRONMENTALDAMAGELOG, SMSG_SPELLLOGMISS, SMSG_LOG_XPGAIN. MSUI's CombatPackets.cs parses every one with matching field order (verified spell-damage and periodic-aura shapes side by side, including the aura-type dispatch constants 3/8/20/21/24/64/89) and Program.Net.cs dispatches them into the combat/floating-text feed.
